key_insight: IFCLoRA allocates LoRA ranks before training using a topology-aware information-flow score, so each Transformer module gets budget based on task-conditioned global importance rather than only local gradients.
engineering_relevance: It improves parameter-efficient fine-tuning accuracy at fixed rank budgets while keeping training cost close to standard LoRA, making it practical for low-memory LLM adaptation.
method: Build a sparse interaction graph from a small calibration set and a frozen pretrained model.
Combine global information-flow topology with local gradient sensitivity to compute Information-Flow Centrality for LoRA-compatible modules.
Assign ranks once under a global budget before fine-tuning.
evidence_signal: Across multiple models, tasks, and low-rank settings, IFCLoRA outperforms LoRA, AdaLoRA, and EVA; on mathematical reasoning with LLaMA 3 8B it improves over LoRA by 1.36% at rank 4 and 1.82% at rank 8.
watch_item: Because the rank allocation depends on a calibration set and graph construction, performance may be sensitive to calibration quality and the chosen interaction sparsity.
paper_title: IFCLoRA: Topology-Aware Rank Allocation for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning
